relationships.subject: maternal separation
relationships.evidence_quote: mice subjected to MS demonstrate a reduction in both the excitatory and inhibitory synaptic activities of parvalbumin interneurons (PVINs) in the anterior cingulate cortex (ACC)

relationships.subject: ACC parvalbumin interneurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Furthermore, inactivation of ACC PVINs blocks transmitted stress.

key_findings: Partners of MS mice show anxiety-like behavior and hyperalgesia; ACC PVINs differ between MS mice (reduced synaptic activity) and Partners (increased number and excitability).
Chemogenetic PVIN inactivation eliminates abnormal behavior in Partners.
